correctness.rationale: Let X,Y lie in T_3(F_q); choose diagonal differences A=(-d+e,a-b),B=(-e+f,b-c), off-diagonal pairs S=(x,s),T=(y,h), central entries R=(z,t). Then [X,Y] strict entries are (A·S,B·T,(A+B)·R+det(S,T)), with q^2 free diagonal choices. Counting the generic A+B nonzero line and the exceptional B=-A determinant equation gives q^3 M(u)M(v)+1_{u=v=0}(q^8 1_{w=0}-q^7), M0=q^3+q^2-q, M1=q^3-q. Summing over w proves simple-root independence; absolute differences give TV=(q-1)/q^5. Every finite field including characteristic 2 is covered. Standalone checker directly enumerated 4096 pairs for F_2, 531441 for F_3 and reduced exact coordinate counts over F_4 and F_5, matching all fibers. Finite checks corroborate but are not a general proof.

originality.rationale: The original claim is the target-by-target additive Lie bracket fiber distribution for all 3x3 upper triangular matrices over every finite field, including nonzero targets, plus a sharp exact central-coordinate uniformity defect. Compared actual scientific literature queries, available prior related mathematical statements, and four pertinent primary sources by theorem implication rather than title. Nearest zero-commutator varieties, full-matrix commuting similarity classes, strictly triangular commutativity-preserving maps, and invertible group commuting probabilities do not entail these nonzero Lie bracket fiber values. Unsearched or partially inspected historical treatments remain a candid residual risk. De Mello arXiv:1910.05469 Theorem 6 and Gargate–de Mello arXiv:2106.12726 Theorem 4.3 already cover image classifications over infinite fields, including surjectivity of commutator onto the radical in that setting; this previously known image theorem is not part of the novelty claim and does not imply any of the uniform finite-field target fiber multiplicities.
residual_risks: Historical literature on fixed commutator-word fibers and bilinear map value distributions may contain an equivalent formula under different terminology.
The 2020 122-page group paper was sampled, not comprehensively read; its full detailed appendices have not been conclusively excluded.
External independent historical priority assessment has not been performed.
The image-surjectivity statement is prior art over infinite fields and is explicitly not claimed original; only finite-field fiber multiplicities and their distribution are proposed as new.

value.rationale: The commutator map is intrinsic to the six-dimensional triangular algebra. Determining every target fiber is a complete natural arithmetic invariant, strictly finer than the commuting probability at zero. The proof isolates an exceptional anti-diagonal-difference locus that causes all central-coordinate dependence and yields a sharp nontrivial total variation distance; such a controlled failure of independence provides a structural boundary for probabilistic and representation-theoretic uses. Exact four-stratum classification holds uniformly for arbitrarily large q, not a small-table computation.
